The '''Kalki Nebula''' was a treacherous [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] [[Nebula/Legends|nebula]] located in the [[Cassander sector/Legends|Cassander sector]]. Long before [[3643 BBY]], a [[Unidentified ancient frigate|frigate]] became adrift in the nebula. When the unresponsive [[Frigate/Legends|starship]] emerged from the nebula around that [[Standard year/Legends|year]], an individual boarded it and recovered its [[Navigator/Legends|navigational data]] as well as some of its cargo. The Kalki Nebula later became a part of the [[Tendrannan sector/Legends|Tendrannan sector]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].

==Description==
The Kalki Nebula was a treacherous [[Nebula/Legends|nebula]]<ref name="A Forgotten Journey">{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Archaeology|A Forgotten Journey}}</ref> that constituted a part of<ref name="GatORW">''[[Geonosis and the Outer Rim Worlds]]''</ref> the [[Star cluster/Legends|star cluster]]<ref name="CSWE Cassandran">{{CSWECite|I|111|Cassandran Worlds}}</ref> that eventually became the [[Tendrannan sector/Legends|Tendrannan sector]], a [[Sector/Legends|subsector]] of the [[Cassander sector/Legends|Cassander sector]]<ref name="EAOC" /> in the [[New Territories/Legends|New Territories]] portion of<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> The nebula shared its name with two astronomical objects in the [[Garqi system/Legends|Garqi system]]: the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kalki]] and the [[Asteroid field/Legends|asteroid field]] known as [[Kalki's Braid]].<ref name="GatORW" />

==History==
Long before the [[Sith Wars/Legends|struggle]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]], a [[Unidentified ancient frigate|frigate]] with cargo aboard became adrift in the Kalki Nebula.<ref name="A Forgotten Journey" /> Around [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="date">Per the reasoning [[Template:TOR_dates|here]], Act I of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' takes place around [[3643 BBY]]. Since players of ''The Old Republic'' can assign their companions on the mission "A Forgotten Journey" independently of the main class storyline at any point during the [[Star Wars video games|game]], the mission must take place at some point around 3643 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]].</ref> the [[Frigate/Legends|frigate]], unresponsive yet well-preserved by [[Vacuum/Legends|vacuum]], emerged from the nebula.<ref name="A Forgotten Journey" />

{{GameMechanics|legends=1|Star Wars: The Old Republic}}
Shortly after the [[Starship/Legends|starship's]] emergence, an individual affiliated with one of the factions in the ongoing Republic&ndash;Sith Empire conflict dispatched a companion to board the vessel, which appeared to be a [[Merchant/Legends|trading]] ship. The companion subsequently recovered the frigate's [[Navigator/Legends|navigation]] logs and some of its preserved cargo.<ref name="A Forgotten Journey" />
{{Endgame}}

When the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] later divided the domain known as the [[Cassandran Worlds/Legends|Cassandran Worlds]] into subsectors,<ref name="GatORW" /> the Kalki Nebula<ref name="EAOC" /> and the [[Parsec/Legends|parsecs]] of half-[[Scout/Legends|explored]] [[Realspace/Legends|space]] surrounding it became a part of the Tendrannan sector.<ref name="GatORW" /> The Kalki Nebula subsequently was situated in the territory of the [[Pentastar Alignment]] between [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]] and [[12 ABY/Legends|12 ABY]]<ref name="TEA" /> and fell within the borders of the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]] between 12 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|ABY]] and [[13 ABY/Legends|13 ABY]].<ref name="EGTW">A map included in ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'' places an astronomical object ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' identifies as the Kalki Nebula in the territory controlled by the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]] between [[12 ABY/Legends|12 ABY]] and [[13 ABY/Legends|13 ABY]].</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Kalki Nebula was first mentioned in the [[2004]] [[Wizards of the Coast]] sourcebook ''[[Geonosis and the Outer Rim Worlds]]''.<ref name="GatORW" /> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed it in grid square L-5.<ref name="TEA" /> The Kalki Nebula was subsequently mentioned in an Archaeology Crew Skill mission of the [[2011]] [[BioWare]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', though the information regarding the mission's outcome was later removed from the game.<ref name="A Forgotten Journey" />
